sql: SELECT TOP 10 az.UserName AS userName, po.StoreCode AS storeCode, MIN(u.UserId) AS userId, MIN(pp.ProfileId) AS profileId FROM dbo.ZnodeUser u INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetUsers a ON a.Id = u.AspNetUserId INNER JOIN dbo.AspNetZnodeUser az ON az.AspNetZnodeUserId = a.UserName INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeUserPortal up ON up.UserId = u.UserId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = up.PortalId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile pp ON pp.PortalId = po.PortalId AND pp.IsDefaultRegistedProfile = @defaultRegisteredProfile WHERE u.AspNetUserId IS NOT NULL AND a.LockoutEnd IS NULL AND po.StoreCode = @store AND (@preferred IS NULL OR az.UserName = @preferred) GROUP BY az.UserName, po.StoreCode ORDER BY az.UserName
